# temps_status_page (Resource)

A public status page showing the state of monitors.

`public_url` stays empty until the Temps server has a public URL configured (Settings > Public ingress); the page is also served at `<temps>/api/status/<slug>`.

`password_wo` and the subscription arguments need a Temps server that provides the status page password and subscription endpoints; on older servers the apply fails with a diagnostic that says so.

Required API key permissions: `status_page:create`, `status_page:read`, `status_page:write`, `status_page:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_status_page" "public" {
  title       = "Example status"
  description = "Current status of the example services."
  published   = true

  monitors = [
    {
      monitor_id   = temps_monitor.web.id
      display_name = "Web"
      group_name   = "Core"
    },
  ]

  appearance = {
    theme                  = "auto"
    show_uptime_percentage = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `monitors` (Attributes List) Monitors shown on the page, in display order. Temps requires at least one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monitors))
- `title` (String) Page title.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `appearance` (Attributes) How the page looks. Unset fields keep the server defaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--appearance))
- `description` (String) Text shown under the title.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only password protecting the page (Terraform 1.11+). Bump `password_wo_version` to change it; remove both to remove the password.
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Change this number to send a new `password_wo`.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the page is publicly reachable.
- `subscription_sender` (String) Sender address for subscription emails, on a verified email domain.
- `subscriptions_enabled` (Boolean) Let visitors subscribe to email updates.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric status page ID.
- `public_json_url` (String) Public JSON summary URL, when the server has a public URL configured.
- `public_url` (String) Public URL, when the server has a public URL configured.
- `slug` (String) Unguessable slug in the page's public path.

<a id="nestedatt--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `monitors`

Required:

- `display_name` (String) Name shown on the page.
- `monitor_id` (Number) ID of a `temps_monitor`.

Optional:

- `group_name` (String) Group heading the monitor is listed under.


<a id="nestedatt--appearance"></a>
### Nested Schema for `appearance`

Optional:

- `accent_color` (String) Accent colour, for example `#2563eb`.
- `logo_url` (String) URL of a logo image.
- `show_response_times` (Boolean) Show response times.
- `show_uptime_percentage` (Boolean) Show uptime percentages.
- `theme` (String) `auto` (default), `light` or `dark`.
- `website_url` (String) Link back to your website.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import temps_status_page.public 2
```
